market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a state deputy from PSOL with no national campaign infrastructure or polling traction. Second-place finishes in Brazilian presidential elections have always gone to major party leaders, and the chance of a minor figure like Santos achieving this is near zero. The market price of 5.5% vastly overstates his odds.
evidence_points: Santos is a São Paulo state deputy, not a nationally known presidential contender.
PSOL has never had a candidate finish in the top two; major parties (PT, PSDB, etc.) dominate.
Even with potential political realignment, Santos lacks the name recognition, funding, or coalition support to reach second place.
